items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: He had Billy Butler, a guy called Bonner, myself, Mutt, Bud Scott, and Fred Walsh on the piano.

ctx.x: I wish you'd tell us a little more about, before you came to New Orleans, out in the country, you know, what kind of places did you play at?

Well, you see I was born on this farm, see, and my daddy, well I hardly played, if I went to the house, I was a little bit of a dance, and I would call it a ball, they'd want to know that you'd get 15 or 20 people in the dance that night, you had a lot of people, see. Because my daddy used to get this on this farm. Who came people from? Different parts of the other plantations came to this. Where did you have the dance? Where did you get it? In the empty house we could find, they could find back those days, see.…
How old were you when you first started to play in places like?
